stem: A chat customer's issue is fixed. Which closing message is most likely to prevent a repeat contact?

options.text: Your refund of 20 pounds is approved and will reach your card within 5 working days. Is there anything else I can help with?
All done! Have a great day!
options.whyWrong: Friendly, but it gives no detail on what happens next.

options.text: The refund is processing and should arrive in due course.
options.whyWrong: No timescale, so the customer is likely to chase.

options.text: Please rate this chat after you close the window.
options.whyWrong: A survey request is not a close; it skips the outcome.

rationale: Stating the outcome, amount and timescale, then checking for anything else, closes the loop and heads off 'where is my refund?' contacts.
